title: ProjectE IPC rule-engine report envelope
description: Shared output shape for the IPC RULE ENGINES (fab_class, dfa). Unlike a calculator these measure supplied observations against a standard's limits, so they carry findings and a verdict. Note that verdict has THREE values: a check that received no observations is NEEDS_HUMAN, not PASS.

subject.description: What was checked — the measurement or placement file path.

params.description: The effective limits and options, echoed back. Includes the source_note so a number's provenance travels with the verdict.

verdict.description: PASS only when every check was really scanned and clean. NEEDS_HUMAN when any check had zero scope. Exit code 0 is reserved for PASS.

limits.description: Honesty notes, required and non-empty. See ipc_calc_report.schema.json for why.

scanned.description: How many items were examined. scanned == 0 MUST carry status NO_COVERAGE; common.findings.Finding rejects any other combination at construction time.
